result.reason: The added clause is mutual, includes the USD 1,000,000 floor, covers all preferred carve-outs, and excludes payment obligations from damages. However, it measures the fee limb over the 12 months preceding the event giving rise to the claim, rather than the 12 months preceding the claim as required; this can materially change the cap for delayed claims. In addition, placing “Except for Excluded Claims” before the entire sentence may exempt Excluded Claims from the consequential-damages exclusion as well as from the cap, creating avoidable ambiguity. The addition is otherwise targeted and professionally drafted.
